[[Rago Kindlerock]] is a [[Stone Summit]] [[boss]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

== Locations ==
* [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Sorrow's Furnace}}
*** during [[The Final Assault]] in the golem room.
*** in the room to the east between [[Marshall Whitman]] and the bridge.
*** during [[Noble Intentions]] while defending Orozar Highstone.
*** during [[Noble Intentions Plan B]] after lowering the bridge.

== Skills ==
* {{Skill icon|Earth Attunement}}
* {{Skill icon|Obsidian Flame}}
* {{Skill icon|Rust}}
* {{Skill icon|Stoning}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Rago's Flame Staff]] ([[unique]])
* [[Rago's Flame Wand]] (unique)
* [[The Kindlerock]] (unique)

== Notes ==
* He seems to appear only if you have a Furnace [[quest]] active. He can drop [[unique]] [[Fire Magic]] [[weapon]]s although it is interesting to note that he uses primarily [[Earth Magic]] skills.
* You can not attack him if you have [[Chains of Enslavement]] on you, since he is a member of the Stone Summit.
